reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in a thread on their message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the site was **Southgate**.

I took this from the incident channel, which Tobias is a member of. On 2025-09-03 Priyanka wrote that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. Her closing message that day said Southgate had cleared the backlog.

The channel doesn't give an address for the site. There were no Tansley account files I could check, so I told Tobias that rather than guess.
